movers.text: Arsenal goalkeeper David Raya (shoulder, hurt at Newcastle 11/21) needs no surgery but missed the Dortmund game; Arteta: 'doesn't look too serious'. Doubt for Man City 11/29.
Chelsea striker João Pedro (thigh) is out until about January (Alonso); Reece James (knee) is also out, and Moisés Caicedo went off vs Leeds on 11/21 with a back knock.
Brentford's first-choice striker Igor Thiago is serving a three-game Premier League ban that began vs Everton on 11/23, so he misses the 11/28 trip to Man United (BBC).
Spurs attackers Xavi Simons and Wilson Odobert (knees), Mathys Tel and Mykhailo Mudryk are out; Sandro Tonali (illness) is a doubt.
Sunderland's joint-top scorer Brian Brobbey (thigh) and midfielder Granit Xhaka (calf) are out with no return date; Dan Ballard and Romaine Mundle are out until late December.

BRE.text: Brentford's first-choice striker Igor Thiago is serving a three-game Premier League ban that began vs Everton on 11/23, so he misses the 11/28 trip to Man United (BBC).
Brentford defenders Nathan Collins (centre-back) and Aaron Hickey (full-back) are out for several weeks, per Keith Andrews; Rico Henry is also out. Lineups confirmed an hour before kickoff.
